caveats: UNSAT results are solver artifacts for encoded ASP instances; no human-readable UNSAT proof or unsat core is claimed.
SAT witnesses are accepted only after independent exhaustive binary verification on all 2^10 inputs.
Runtime is operational only and is not used as structural evidence.
U-duality is used only for U-type depths, not V-type depths.
The n=10 sorting-network upper bound is sourced from local literature notes and bibliography; it is an upper bound for V/U selection via full sorting.

U: UDepth(2,10)=5 from depth-4 UNSAT and depth-5 verified SAT; no U(3)->U(2) witness implication is used.
UDepth(3,10), UDepth(4,10), and UDepth(5,10) are direct depth-5 verified SAT upper bounds combined with n=9 lower bounds.
UDepth(6,10), UDepth(7,10), UDepth(8,10), and UDepth(9,10) are filled by U-duality.
V: V(2,10) depth 5 UNSAT plus verified V(3,10) depth-6 witness gives VDepth(2,10)=6 because V3 implies V2.
VDepth(3,10)=6 from VDepth(3,9)=6 by monotonicity and a verified depth-6 witness.
VDepth(t,10)=7 for t>=4 from VDepth(4,9)=7 by monotonicity, V(t) lower-bound transfer for t>=4, and the n=10 depth-7 full-sorting upper bound.
